context_for_next_testing_agent: Gamification system fully implemented and tested. Key endpoints: /api/gamification/profile (returns level, points, achievements), /api/gamification/achievements (returns categorized achievements), /api/gamification/leaderboard (returns rankings). Story creation awards 10 XP, voice note upload awards 5 XP. XPToast component displays notifications, AchievementCelebration shows modal on achievement unlock. Both components are mounted in App.js root.
